All funeral bodies already explain condolence ribbon, sender names, four products, basic-versus-total budget, current room/departure timing, mixed materials, reception consultation and cancellation. These are necessary common business explanations, not new Dongjak differentiators.

Guro wedding covers Weddingcity/Sindorim, Ramada, The Link and G-Tower; Yeongdeungpo wedding covers JK, The Partyum and Withus; Gangseo wedding covers Mayfield. New Dongjak wedding text cannot simply substitute venue names into these common order and ribbon paragraphs.

Gangseo M+ and Guro digital valley bodies already cover office opening, relocation versus new business wording, real address, floor/unit, recipient schedule, budget, entry conditions and no collection. Dongjak generic office content repeats the same decision without sufficient new verified destination information.

Gangseo performance already separates artist/team gift, event time versus reception time, no collection, hall-versus-gallery rule and gallery wreath ban. A general Dongjak performance page would need current venue/event evidence beyond this existing treatment.

Best new funeral value is the CAU official rule: wreath placement in the memorial room, not corridors, and prohibition of unauthorized removal of used flowers.
